summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Kathleen Sebelius, an American businesswoman and Democratic politician. It covers her roles as 21st United States Secretary of Health and Human Services (2009 to 2014) and as 44th Governor of Kansas (2003 to 2009). It also notes her 2008 State of the Union response, her leadership of the Democratic Governors Association, and her April 2014 resignation announcement.
one_line: Kathleen Sebelius is an American Democratic politician who served as Kansas governor and as U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services.
key_facts: Kathleen Sebelius was born May 15, 1948, with the maiden name Gilligan.
Kathleen Sebelius is an American businesswoman and politician.
Kathleen Sebelius served as the 21st United States Secretary of Health and Human Services from 2009 until 2014.
Kathleen Sebelius was the 44th Governor of Kansas from 2003 to 2009.
Kathleen Sebelius was the second woman to hold the office of Governor of Kansas.
Kathleen Sebelius is a member of the Democratic Party.
Kathleen Sebelius was the Democratic respondent to the 2008 State of the Union address.
Kathleen Sebelius is chair-emerita of the Democratic Governors Association.
Kathleen Sebelius was the first female chair of the Democratic Governors Association.
On April 10, 2014, Kathleen Sebelius announced her resignation as Secretary of Health and Human Services.
Kathleen Sebelius is CEO of Sebelius Resources LLC.
